test_roundtrip_pickle: test pickling and unpickling a pybind11 Pickleable object to verify value and extra attributes survive serialization
test_roundtrip_with_dict: test pickling a pybind11 PickleableWithDict object to verify dynamic attributes and __dict__ survive serialization
test_enum_pickle: test pickling and unpickling a pybind11 enum value to verify it roundtrips correctly
test_roundtrip_simple_py_derived: test pickling a Python-derived class from a pybind11 SimpleBase to verify attributes and type survive serialization
test_roundtrip_simple_cpp_derived: test pickling a C++-derived pybind11 object to verify object slicing behavior and attribute preservation
